D5/S3/Arith/Congruence/PadicBallFiberCor.signature: theorem congruenceFiber_eq_closedBall_inter_range (p k : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (x : ℤ) : congruenceFiber p k x = Metric.closedBall (x : ℚ_[p]) ((p : ℝ) ^ (-k : ℤ)) ∩ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℚ_[p])
